entities.name: Keppel Harcourt Barnard
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Keppel Harcourt Barnard was a South African zoologist and museum director. He was the only son of Harcourt George Barnard, a solicitor from Lambeth, and Anne Elizabeth Porter of Royston.
